description: This file contains HTML with embedded JavaScript code that creates and manipulates graphical UI components using the Isomorphic SmartClient framework. It defines visual elements such as an image widget and a toolbar with controls to manipulate the widget's properties, such as visibility, size, and position.

methods.name: Img.create
methods.description: Creates an image widget with specified properties such as ID, position, size, and source.

methods.name: Toolbar.create
methods.description: Creates a toolbar widget with buttons that perform actions on the image widget, such as changing visibility, size, or position.
